properties.evidence: That change made sync_debt::unexported_work the one producer of the export sentence ("A record is the only copy that survives losing the graph directory: export before you finish"). It returns nothing when the seat has no in-step tracked record (`let best = best?`). Sync records are a sidecar beside the store (provenance.rs read_sync_state), so a store imported onto a host starts with none. flo2 strips export_graph's `path`, so a hosted store never gets one. Measured on 0.72.0: silence on a registry-served store, and the sentence appears on a local store only after a tracked export.
